mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_tasks (run_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id VARCHAR(128), user_id VARCHAR(128), session_id VARCHAR(200), request_id VARCHAR(200), created_at BIGINT, payload CLOB, UNIQUE(tenant_id,user_id,request_id))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_instructions (run_id VARCHAR(64), instruction_id VARCHAR(200), fingerprint VARCHAR(64), response CLOB, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,instruction_id))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_windows (window_key VARCHAR(400) PRIMARY KEY, started_at BIGINT, calls INT, tokens BIGINT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_sessions (tenant_id VARCHAR(128), user_id VARCHAR(128), session_id VARCHAR(200), current_run_id VARCHAR(64), PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,user_id,session_id))
mapper.select: SELECT payload FROM supervisor_tasks WHERE run_id=#{runId}
SELECT payload FROM supervisor_tasks ORDER BY created_at
SELECT fingerprint,response FROM supervisor_instructions WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND instruction_id=#{instructionId}
SELECT started_at,calls,tokens FROM supervisor_windows WHERE window_key=#{windowKey}
SELECT current_run_id FROM supervisor_sessions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND session_id=#{sessionId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM supervisor_sessions WHERE current_run_id NOT IN (SELECT run_id FROM supervisor_tasks)
